role: Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering, UWM, commenter
stance_basis: testified and wrote that Draft EIS was deficient for not addressing combined airport and spur noise exposure
summary: Professor W. Wayne Siesennop, an Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering at UWM, was requested by a private group of citizens to evaluate the noise exposure forecast in the Draft EIS. He testified at the public hearing and submitted a supplementary letter, both raising the same concern that the Draft EIS was deficient because it failed to address the combined noise exposure from the Airport Spur and aircraft noise together. His complaints received a response directing readers to pages 121 and 125 of the Final EIS.
complaint_summary: Siesennop submitted a letter supplementing his public hearing testimony, reiterating his concern that the Draft EIS failed to address the combined noise exposure from the Airport Spur and aircraft noise.
